name: 108-robust-countdown-frozen-in-error
description: Robustness: a 5 s sleep countdown starts about 1.2 s before the playhead runs dry at the end of 2 while 3 keeps failing (Error). The countdown counts playing time only: no SleepFired during 8 s of Error; after a skip back into buffered audio it fires about 3.8 s later.
